# hpe_morpheus_monitoring_check (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Monitoring Check resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_monitoring_check" "example" {
  name           = "Website Health"
  check_type_id  = 1
  description    = "HTTP health check for production website"
  check_interval = 60
  active         = true
  severity       = "critical"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_type_id` (Number) The check type ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the monitoring check.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the check is active.
- `check_interval` (Number) Check interval in seconds.
- `description` (String) The description of the monitoring check.
- `in_uptime` (Boolean) Whether the check affects account-wide availability calculations.
- `severity` (String) Severity level threshold for sending notifications.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the monitoring check.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_monitoring_check.example 123
```
